teaching_note: The Cyber Kill Chain is a lifecycle model for organizing a hypothesized intrusion, not a law requiring every event to occur in a visible linear sequence [@ageint061]. A missing phase can mean missing telemetry, an inapplicable model or no intrusion; it is not permission to invent a bridging event. Separate observed record order, inferred causal order and the model's teaching sequence.
title: The Cyber Kill Chain (Lockheed Martin)

raw: 12.2 MITRE ATT&CK Framework: Enterprise Matrix v19[^63][^64]
teaching_note: ATT&CK organizes adversary objectives and reported behaviours, not sequential stages; a mapping classifies a supported behaviour and does not confirm an incident, attribute an actor or prove a control works [@ageint063; @ageint064]. The raw v19 heading is inherited provenance, not a pin for mutable URLs: require a supplied release and entry before accepting any release-specific labels or counts. In a fictional timeline, records at 09:00 and 09:20 both show inventory enumeration, separated by a 09:10 authorized administrative process start; repeated behaviour does not imply passage through intervening tactics or completion of a lifecycle. Candidate discovery/execution labels remain hypotheses pending discriminating fields and release definitions; actor, intrusion status and detection effectiveness are unknown. Missing or ambiguous mappings stay unknown rather than filling a checklist.
title: MITRE ATT&CK Framework: Enterprise Matrix (Inherited v19 Reference)

teaching_note: Reconnaissance concerns information gathering, whereas resource development concerns preparing resources; neither follows from a record merely mentioning an external address. In a fictional offline log, 'lookup requested, result unavailable' supports a lookup event, not adversarial preparation or ownership of the address. Preserve that distinction without collecting additional information about a real service.
title: Reconnaissance through Resource Development

raw: 12.2.2 Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation[^65]
teaching_note: Access, execution, retained access and increased privilege are different propositions requiring different observations. A supplied process-start record can establish that a process was recorded without establishing its entry route, persistent configuration or privilege change. For every candidate technique, retain the exact record field and release-specific definition that discriminate it from routine administration [@ageint065].
title: Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation

raw: 12.2.3 Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement
teaching_note: These inherited tactic labels must be checked against the supplied ATT&CK release rather than treated as an immutable list. Discovery of a resource, access to credentials and movement between systems are not interchangeable, and a failed authentication does not establish any of them by itself. ATLAS addresses AI-system threats while the NIST supply-chain and SSDF references address software assurance; those sources do not substantiate a specific Enterprise ATT&CK mapping, so an ungrounded mapping remains unsupported.
title: Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement

teaching_note: Distinguish assembling data, communicating control, transferring data beyond an authorized boundary and changing system availability or integrity. A supplied byte-count increase alone does not establish what moved, why, or whether an authorized boundary was crossed. Routine backup and missing sensor coverage are discriminating alternatives; retain unknown content and intent rather than completing a narrative from taxonomy labels.
title: Collection, Command & Control, Exfiltration, Impact

raw: 12.3 Unified Kill Chain: Extending Lockheed + MITRE[^62]
teaching_note: The Unified Kill Chain is another modelling lens, not a merger that makes all phases empirically inevitable. Contrast models by whether they expose different missing observations in the same supplied timeline, not by which yields more labels. The inherited encyclopedia reference is secondary orientation and cannot establish a model's predictive validity, incident-specific causation or optimal intervention point.
title: Unified Kill Chain: Extending Lockheed + MITRE

teaching_note: STIX represents observations, indicators, sightings and relationships as distinct assertions; TAXII transports content but neither verifies truth nor authorizes distribution, and TAXII 2.1 specifies Collections while reserving Channels without specifying their services [@ageint067; @ageint068; @ageint310]. In a completed fictional packet, O1 observes artifact H at 09:00, indicator I1 version 1 at 10:00 asserts H is suspicious from source S1, sighting Sg1 at 10:05 references that assertion, O2 copies O1, and relation R1 names an actor without evidence; deduplication leaves one observation lineage, a sourced suspicion and an unsupported actor edge, not three confirmations. I1 version 2 at 11:00 is supplied as revoked, so the historical assertion remains in the record but cannot silently serve as an active indicator; its confidence rationale was a single-source judgment, not an incident probability. A supplied classroom handling card permits course group G only: a proposed export to group H is rejected even if serialization is valid, while no live TAXII transaction occurs. Copying O1 must not raise corroboration, withdrawing S1 removes the suspicion's support, and a protocol success changes neither attribution nor the right to share.
title: Threat Intelligence Sharing: STIX/TAXII Standards

raw: 12.5 Nation-State Cyber Espionage: Motivations and Methods[^69]
teaching_note: Espionage, disruption and financial gain are candidate objectives, not directly observed motives inferred from a tool name or victim sector. A study of a selected incident corpus cannot automatically establish base rates for all state activity or classify an unseen event. Without inspected methods, sampling and attribution criteria, this lesson leaves numerical prevalence and individual-event sponsorship unknown rather than generalizing the inherited study reference.
title: Nation-State Cyber Espionage: Motivations and Methods

raw: 12.6 Chinese State-Affiliated Hacking: APT10, APT41, Volt Typhoon[^9][^70]

Without a dated primary attribution statement tied to each claim, affiliation and alias equivalence remain unsupported here; no live actor or infrastructure investigation is performed.
title: Chinese State-Affiliated Hacking: APT10, APT41, Volt Typhoon

raw: 12.7 Russian Cyber Operations: Sandworm, Cozy Bear, Fancy Bear
teaching_note: Vendor cluster names, government attribution statements and organizational identities are different objects and may not have one-to-one alias relationships. The attached ATLAS, supply-chain and SSDF references do not establish the named groups' Russian affiliations or incident histories; those specific assertions remain unsupported without appropriate dated reporting. A tool or behaviour overlap is a reason to compare hypotheses, not to assign nationality or merge clusters.
title: Russian Cyber Operations: Sandworm, Cozy Bear, Fancy Bear

teaching_note: Living-off-the-land describes misuse of legitimate capabilities, so the presence of an administrative utility is not itself evidence of malicious conduct. Distinguish the observed invocation, authorized task context and claimed objective using supplied inert records; absent context leaves intent unresolved. The Reddit AMA interest-check is not an authoritative LOTL specification or validated detection method, and this lesson gives no commands, evasion instructions or operational response.
title: Living-Off-The-Land (LOTL) Techniques in APT Operations
